context.body: A child hears the word that has become rare and must carry a severe message.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD calls Samuel, confirms judgment on Eli’s house, and establishes Samuel as a trustworthy prophet.
observations.label: God calls Samuel in a time of rare words: action

observations.body: Samuel initially mistakes the voice, learns to answer, fears to report, and tells Eli everything.
observations.label: God calls Samuel in a time of rare words: response

observations.body: word was rare · called · speak · let none fall
observations.label: Words in 1 Samuel 3:1–21

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 3:1–21 as land, judges, and kings evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The call establishes Samuel through a judgment he did not choose and cannot soften.
payload.title: God calls Samuel in a time of rare words
